meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 核对本机 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装是否健康且与最新版一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 Codex 开发,最近一次安装、升级或改配置后遇到了奇怪问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and hit odd behavior after an install, update, or config change

howto.what: 检查你本地的 LazyCodex/Codex 安装、配置和插件,与最新源码对比,输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,每个结论都附证据。它只做诊断,不会改动你的安装或配置。
howto.when: 当你说出“LazyCodex”、“omo-codex”等关键词,或要求健康检查/诊断,或在安装、更新或改配置后 Codex 行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LazyCodex 安装的健康状况。
升级 Codex 后行为有点怪,请帮我诊断。
say.note: Claude 会与最新源码对比,定位偏差。

say.text: 请对比我本地的 LazyCodex 和最新版有没有偏差。
say.note: Claude 会同步最新源码后给出对比结果。

howto.what_en: Checks your local LazyCodex/Codex install, config, and plugins against the latest sources, then outputs a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence for each verdict. It only diagnoses; it never changes your install or config.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or similar; ask for a health check/diagnosis; or report Codex acting oddly after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Check the health of my LazyCodex install.
say_en.note: Claude returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence.

say_en.text: Codex acted oddly after the upgrade, can you diagnose?
say_en.note: Claude compares against latest sources to find drift.

say_en.text: Compare my local LazyCodex with the latest release.
say_en.note: Claude syncs latest sources and reports any mismatch.
